newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Fuel and machinery mobilised for Siberian harvest.
newsitem.headline: Fuel and machinery mobilised for Siberian harvest.

text.p: Russia is mobilising machinery, spare parts and fuel from its defence ministry and other organisations to increase the pace of the harvest in Siberia, Interfax news agency said on Friday.
It quoted agriculture ministry sources as saying that an additional 82 combines, out of a targeted 143, would soon be sent to far-flung grain-bearing regions.

The government sent 300 billion roubles to Siberian authorities in August alone to acquire spare parts for tractors and combines, and 1,310 farming vehicles from the defence ministry had been mobilised to help bring in grains.
Interfax said officials had given farms 1.65 million tonnes of gasoline and 3.48 million tonnes of diesel by the first week of September.
Heavy rains and a late sowing have slowed the pace of the harvest in Siberia, whose output is important for regional supplies.
Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Zaveryukha, in charge of the harvest, said earlier this week that Russian was concerned about the pace of grain-gathering in Siberia.
